minor.issue: This read route sends saved ai_solution.solution to the client without checking it against the TenMark shape. A legacy or malformed tag, e.g. one missing 'difficulty', reaches the client and crashes the Results screen (see the frontend issue). Validate or normalise the shape, or treat the tag as not ready.

ui_bugs.issue: The 32px gap below the banner is missing; it measures 0px on both desktop and mobile. Root cause: live-series.css line 1 targets `.direct-exam-home>.flagship-banner`, but no JS file uses the class 'direct-exam-home'. Home.js renders `container page exam-home`, so the rule is dead. Fix: change the selector to `.exam-home>.flagship-banner`, or add the class in Home.js.

The code calls `s.difficulty.toLowerCase()`, `s.given.length` and `s.common_mistakes.length` without guards. If a saved tag lacks one of these fields, the error boundary replaces the whole Results page with 'We couldn't open this screen'. Reproduced with a tag that had no difficulty field. Add optional chaining and defaults so one bad card cannot take down the page.

issues: For wide crops (1400px fixture), Readable mode gives the same scale as Fit on desktop. The ratio is max(fit, 760/naturalWidth), so text stays small until the user presses zoom-in. Consider a minimum readable scale.
On mobile, the fullscreen 'Source detail' dialog opens at Fit, which leaves a tiny image at the top of a 308x361 canvas. Consider opening it in Readable mode on narrow screens.
The text 'AI generated by gpt-6-astra' is hardcoded regardless of the tag's provenance or model. Consider deriving it from saved provenance.

action_items: Fix the /home banner bottom gap: the selector `.direct-exam-home>.flagship-banner` in live-series.css matches nothing. Use `.exam-home>.flagship-banner` (32px).
Harden AiSolution.js against missing difficulty, given or common_mistakes. Optionally validate saved tag shape in the ai-solutions read route.
Optional UX: make Readable mode enlarge wide crops; open fullscreen source detail in Readable mode on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: live-series.css: the dead selector `.direct-exam-home` is the root cause of the missing 32px home gap.

AiSolution.js: the model name 'gpt-6-astra' is a hardcoded string, not taken from data.

rca of the issue: Home gap: the CSS selector targets the class 'direct-exam-home', which is not rendered; Home.js uses 'exam-home'. Reproduce by opening /home and measuring the banner bottom against the next element top: 0px. Results crash: the first run used a fixture tag without 'difficulty', which caused TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toLowerCase') in AiSolution and triggered the error boundary. After the fixture was fixed to the full TenMark shape, Results rendered correctly. Real tags pass TenMark validation (difficulty is required), so the risk is limited to legacy or manually seeded tags.
